senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.; cmp. אַפְקוֹתָא) [that which branches off,] neck, nape.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 113a:14">Ḥull. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>השובר מִפְרַקְתָּהּ וכ׳</he> he who breaks the neck of a slaughtered animal before it is dead.

<cite ref="Zevachim 65b:9">Zeb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>חותך שדרה ומ׳</he> he cuts (with his nail) the spinal column and the nape; <cite ref="Chullin 21a:7">Ḥull. 21ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 28a">28ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 10b:2">Ib. 10ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>בעצם דמ׳ איפגים</he> the knife may have been notched on striking the neck-bone; a. fr.
